contract: HSP-18 (VISION.md:1261): static scan plus credential-unset matrix, every migrated consumer either uses the socket or fails closed. HSP-01 (VISION.md:1244): fixture is a migrated consumer with fake provider credential and direct-client imports; assert only the allowlisted houndd adapter reaches the provider and direct/hound_cli paths fail closed.

hsp_quotes.HSP-01: There is one external-ingestion boundary after cutover: all external search, URL extraction, capture, file/media intake, and transcription goes through houndd-owned adapters and is journaled; hound_cli is repository execution only and is not an acquisition boundary. Fixture: migrated consumer with fake provider credential and direct-client imports. Test/command: static boundary checker plus Unix-socket integration test with the credential unset. Assert: only the allowlisted houndd adapter reaches the provider; direct and hound_cli acquisition paths fail closed. Retain: boundary scan JSON and journal event bundle.
hsp_quotes.HSP-18: No-bypass enforcement statically rejects provider credentials/endpoints/direct clients/prompt direct skills/artifacts without Hound IDs outside the explicit adapter allowlist, with exclusions only for tests/history/local retrieval/health/deploy/publish; dynamic tests run every migrated consumer with credentials unset. Fixture: positive forbidden-pattern corpus, allowed houndd adapter corpus, and every migrated consumer. Test/command: static scan plus credential-unset matrix. Assert: forbidden consumers fail the scan, allowlisted adapters pass, exclusions are limited to the stated set, and every consumer either uses the socket or fails closed. Retain: scan findings, exclusion manifest, and consumer matrix.

method.summary: Two independent proofs per HSP-18: (1) a live credential-unset run against an ephemeral keyless houndd for every migrated lane pattern, re-run fresh for this consolidation rather than only citing the cutover-time proofs; (2) a static scan of the whole workspace for provider indicators outside the houndd seam.

live_proof.daemon: ephemeral houndd at current HEAD, state root and Unix socket under scratch (not the production state root, not houndd.service)
live_proof.credential_unset: houndd serve launched via `env -u EXA_API_KEY -u FIRECRAWL_API_KEY -u FIRECRAWL_ENDPOINT -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u DEEPGRAM_API_KEY -u GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`; houndd.adapter_host.AdapterHost.from_env snapshots ADAPTER_ENV_KEYS = (EXA_API_KEY, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, FIRECRAWL_ENDPOINT, OPENAI_API_KEY) once at process start, so ingest.search/ingest.url/transcribe have no registered adapter for the whole process lifetime -- this is a true keyless daemon, not a per-request credential check that could race.
live_proof.policy: generated via `uv run python -m migration.check_policy --emit` from migration/consumer-inventory.v1.json + migration/policy_overlay.v1.json (the same generator GOALIE.md's federation-root-fix task produces the live policy from) -- not hand-written -- copied verbatim into migration/evidence/e1/policy-used.json. Grants each lane owner (gc-benefits, gc-web, gc-wiki, gc-intel) ingest.search/ingest.url/record.get/journal.query on their own producer scope, matching the inventory's target_ops per acquisition lane.
live_proof.phi_clear_manifest: one deliberate entry for a throwaway local fixture (used only to mint a real capture record for the transcribe proof); every other byte sequence, including the separate source_refused fixture, has no matching (sha256, media_type, encoding) tuple and is scanned as 'suspected' -> source_refused.
live_proof.state_hygiene: production state root (~/.local/state/hound) and houndd.service were never touched -- confirmed empty/untouched after teardown; daemon killed and socket removed at the end of the run.

method.static_scan: uv run python -m migration.check_domain_ownership --workspace /home/deploy --json, output saved verbatim to migration/evidence/e1/ownership-scan.json.
